name: Map Maker: Decoration
note: Catalog of every decoration of the game (generated by tools/make_map_maker_helper.py from the game data). The plane starts in the middle; the decorations are in rows, with the name written on the floor in front of each, on a plain floor with walls all around. /room N jumps to a group of rows. Nothing ends this map: leave with /leave.

drawing.legend: . free floor, - no floor. First line = last sj row (the back). The walls are the edge walls of the floor (wallsOnEdges).
